structured_output.what_is_happening: A cluster of "p(doom)" tokens launched on Solana within the last ~2 hours. The name is the AI-risk shorthand linked to Eliezer Yudkowsky. The packet's GeckoTerminal twitter field points to an "allTheYud" X status, which suggests the wave was triggered by an X post. This token (GLL1…) was created at about 10:20 UTC. It is at least the 9th same-name clone. The leading clone, Aq7r…, is at a $2.7M market cap, and three others (Exk6, ARPw, Bra6) are at roughly $60k–$830k. This token's own metadata description links to the Solscan page of a different clone (ARPw…), which points to a copy-paste launch. It rose about 388% to a ~$50k market cap in 15 minutes. It has 53 bundler wallets, a top-bundler trader share of 44%, and 2,100 unique buyers against only 86 sellers, a ratio that looks bot-made. The creator has already closed their position. In the last 5 minutes buys and sells are about even and market cap slipped from $55.6k to $50.2k.
